theorem Axler_exercise_5_12 {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F]
  [Module F V] {S : End F V}
  (hS : ∀ v : V, ∃ c : F, v ∈ eigenspace S c) :
  ∃ c : F, S = c • LinearMap.id := by
  have hS' : ∀ v : V, ∃ c : F, S v = c • v := by
    intro v
    rcases hS v with ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact ⟨c, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hc⟩
  by_cases hV : ∀ v : V, v = 0
  · use 0
    ext v
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, hV v, map_zero, smul_zero]
  · push_neg at hV
    rcases hV with ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩
    rcases hS' v₀ with ⟨c, hc⟩
    use c
    ext w
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
    rcases hS' w with ⟨d, hd⟩
    by_cases h_ind : ∃ k : F, w = k • v₀
    · rcases h_ind with ⟨k, rfl⟩
      rw [map_smul, hc, smul_comm]
    · rcases hS' (v₀ + w) with ⟨e, he⟩
      have h_eq : (c - e) • v₀ = (e - d) • w := by
        apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
        calc (c - e) • v₀ - (e - d) • w
          _ = (c • v₀ + d • w) - (e • v₀ + e • w) := by
            rw [sub_smul, sub_smul]
            abel
          _ = (S v₀ + S w) - e • (v₀ + w) := by rw [hc, hd, smul_add]
          _ = S (v₀ + w) - e • (v₀ + w) := by rw [← map_add]
          _ = e • (v₀ + w) - e • (v₀ + w) := by rw [he]
          _ = 0 := sub_self _
      have hed : e = d := by
        by_contra h_ne
        have h_sub : e - d ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h_ne
        have hw : w = ((e - d)⁻¹ * (c - e)) • v₀ := by
          calc w
            _ = (e - d)⁻¹ • (e - d) • w := (inv_smul_smul₀ h_sub w).symm
            _ = (e - d)⁻¹ • (c - e) • v₀ := by rw [← h_eq]
            _ = ((e - d)⁻¹ * (c - e)) • v₀ := by rw [mul_smul]
        exact h_ind ⟨(e - d)⁻¹ * (c - e), hw⟩
      have hcd : c = d := by
        have h2 : (c - e) • v₀ = 0 := by rw [h_eq, hed, sub_self, zero_smul]
        have h3 : c - e = 0 := by
          cases smul_eq_zero.mp h2 with
          | inl h => exact h
          | inr h => exact False.elim (hv₀ h)
        have h4 : c = e := sub_eq_zero.mp h3
        rw [h4, hed]
      rw [hd, ← hcd]

theorem Axler_exercise_5_12 {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F]
  [Module F V] {S : End F V}
  (hS : ∀ v : V, ∃ c : F, v ∈ eigenspace S c) :
  ∃ c : F, S = c • LinearMap.id := by
  classical
  by_cases hTrivial : ∀ v : V, v = 0
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    ext v
    have hv : v = 0 := hTrivial v
    simp [hv]
  · have h_exists_ne : ∃ v : V, v ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      exact hTrivial h
    obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := h_exists_ne
    obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := hS v₀
    have hS_v₀ : S v₀ = c₀ • v₀ := by rwa [mem_eigenspace_iff] at hc₀
    have key : ∀ w : V, S w = c₀ • w := by
      intro w
      by_cases hw0 : w = 0
      · simp [hw0]
      · by_cases hMult : ∃ a : F, w = a • v₀
        · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hMult
          calc S w = S (a • v₀) := by rw [ha]
            _ = a • S v₀ := map_smul S a v₀
            _ = a • c₀ • v₀ := by rw [hS_v₀]
            _ = c₀ • a • v₀ := by rw [smul_comm a c₀ v₀]
            _ = c₀ • w := by rw [← ha]
        · obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁⟩ := hS w
          have hS_w : S w = c₁ • w := by rwa [mem_eigenspace_iff] at hc₁
          obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂⟩ := hS (v₀ + w)
          have hS_vw : S (v₀ + w) = c₂ • (v₀ + w) := by rwa [mem_eigenspace_iff] at hc₂
          have hEq : c₀ • v₀ + c₁ • w = c₂ • v₀ + c₂ • w := by
            have h1 : S (v₀ + w) = S v₀ + S w := map_add S v₀ w
            rw [hS_v₀, hS_w, hS_vw, smul_add] at h1
            exact h1.symm
          have hEq' : (c₀ - c₂) • v₀ + (c₁ - c₂) • w = 0 := by
            calc (c₀ - c₂) • v₀ + (c₁ - c₂) • w
                = (c₀ • v₀ - c₂ • v₀) + (c₁ • w - c₂ • w) := by
                    rw [sub_smul, sub_smul]
              _ = (c₀ • v₀ + c₁ • w) - (c₂ • v₀ + c₂ • w) := by abel
              _ = 0 := by rw [hEq, sub_self]
          have h_c1_eq_c2 : c₁ = c₂ := by
            by_contra h_ne
            have h_sub_ne : c₁ - c₂ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h_ne
            have h2 : (c₁ - c₂) • w = (c₂ - c₀) • v₀ := by
              have h3 : (c₁ - c₂) • w = -((c₀ - c₂) • v₀) := by
                calc (c₁ - c₂) • w
                    = (c₁ - c₂) • w + (c₀ - c₂) • v₀ - (c₀ - c₂) • v₀ := by abel
                  _ = 0 - (c₀ - c₂) • v₀ := by rw [add_comm, hEq']
                  _ = -((c₀ - c₂) • v₀) := by abel
              calc (c₁ - c₂) • w = -((c₀ - c₂) • v₀) := h3
                _ = (-(c₀ - c₂)) • v₀ := by rw [neg_smul]
                _ = (c₂ - c₀) • v₀ := by rw [neg_sub]
            have h_w_eq : w = ((c₁ - c₂)⁻¹ * (c₂ - c₀)) • v₀ := by
              have h4 : (c₁ - c₂)⁻¹ • ((c₁ - c₂) • w) = (c₁ - c₂)⁻¹ • ((c₂ - c₀) • v₀) := by
                rw [h2]
              rw [inv_smul_smul₀ h_sub_ne] at h4
              rw [smul_smul] at h4
              exact h4
            exact hMult ⟨(c₁ - c₂)⁻¹ * (c₂ - c₀), h_w_eq⟩
          have h_c0_eq_c2 : c₀ = c₂ := by
            have h : (c₀ - c₂) • v₀ = 0 := by
              rw [h_c1_eq_c2, sub_self, zero_smul, add_zero] at hEq'
              exact hEq'
            have h_sub_zero : c₀ - c₂ = 0 := by
              by_contra h_ne
              exact (smul_ne_zero h_ne hv₀) h
            exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_sub_zero
          calc S w = c₁ • w := hS_w
            _ = c₂ • w := by rw [h_c1_eq_c2]
            _ = c₀ • w := by rw [h_c0_eq_c2]
    refine ⟨c₀, ?_⟩
    ext v
    have hv := key v
    simp [hv]

  ∃ c : F, S = c • LinearMap.id := by

  by_cases hV : ∀ v : V, v = 0

    ext v
    have hv : v = 0 := hV v
    simp [hv, map_zero]
  · push_neg at hV
    obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := hV
    obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := hS v₀
    have hS₀ : S v₀ = c₀ • v₀ := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hc₀
    use c₀
    ext v
    simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
    obtain ⟨cv, hcv⟩ := hS v
    have hSv : S v = cv • v := Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hcv
    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · simp [hv, map_zero]
    · by_cases hmult : ∃ a : F, v = a • v₀
      · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hmult
        calc S v = S (a • v₀) := by rw [ha]
          _ = a • S v₀ := map_smul S a v₀
          _ = a • (c₀ • v₀) := by rw [hS₀]
          _ = (a * c₀) • v₀ := by rw [smul_smul]
          _ = (c₀ * a) • v₀ := by rw [mul_comm]
          _ = c₀ • (a • v₀) := by rw [← smul_smul]
          _ = c₀ • v := by rw [← ha]
      · obtain ⟨csum, hcsum⟩ := hS (v₀ + v)
        have hSsum : S (v₀ + v) = csum • (v₀ + v) :=
          Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hcsum
        have h_eq : (c₀ - csum) • v₀ + (cv - csum) • v = 0 := by
          have h1 : S (v₀ + v) = S v₀ + S v := map_add S v₀ v
          have h2 : csum • (v₀ + v) = csum • v₀ + csum • v := smul_add csum v₀ v
          calc (c₀ - csum) • v₀ + (cv - csum) • v
              = (c₀ • v₀ - csum • v₀) + (cv • v - csum • v) := by
                simp [sub_smul]
            _ = (c₀ • v₀ + cv • v) - (csum • v₀ + csum • v) := by abel
            _ = (S v₀ + S v) - (csum • v₀ + csum • v) := by
                rw [← hS₀, ← hSv]
            _ = S (v₀ + v) - csum • (v₀ + v) := by
                rw [← h1, ← h2]
            _ = csum • (v₀ + v) - csum • (v₀ + v) := by rw [hSsum]
            _ = 0 := sub_self _
        have hcv_eq : cv = csum := by
          by_contra hne
          have hne' : cv - csum ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
          have h_cv : (cv - csum) • v = (csum - c₀) • v₀ := by
            have hb : (cv - csum) • v = - ((c₀ - csum) • v₀) := by
              have h' : (cv - csum) • v + (c₀ - csum) • v₀ = 0 := by
                rw [add_comm]; exact h_eq
              exact add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.mp h'
            calc (cv - csum) • v = - ((c₀ - csum) • v₀) := hb
              _ = (-(c₀ - csum)) • v₀ := by rw [← neg_smul]
              _ = (csum - c₀) • v₀ := by rw [neg_sub]
          have hv_eq : v = ((csum - c₀) / (cv - csum)) • v₀ := by
            calc v = (cv - csum)⁻¹ • ((cv - csum) • v) :=
                  (inv_smul_smul₀ hne' v).symm
              _ = (cv - csum)⁻¹ • ((csum - c₀) • v₀) := by rw [h_cv]
              _ = (((cv - csum)⁻¹ * (csum - c₀)) • v₀) := by rw [smul_smul]
              _ = (((csum - c₀) / (cv - csum)) • v₀) := by
                  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
          exact hmult ⟨(csum - c₀) / (cv - csum), hv_eq⟩
        have hc₀_eq : c₀ = csum := by
          have h_zero : (c₀ - csum) • v₀ = 0 := by
            have h1 : (cv - csum) • v = 0 := by
              rw [hcv_eq, sub_self, zero_smul]
            calc (c₀ - csum) • v₀ = (c₀ - csum) • v₀ + 0 := by rw [add_zero]
              _ = (c₀ - csum) • v₀ + (cv - csum) • v := by rw [← h1]

          have h_sub : c₀ - csum = 0 := by
            by_contra hne
            exact smul_ne_zero hne hv₀ h_zero
          exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_sub
        calc S v = cv • v := hSv
          _ = csum • v := by rw [hcv_eq]
          _ = c₀ • v := by rw [← hc₀_eq]
